method: flash, then an ordinary serial open+close of the programming port at 115200 - what any tool does - then ask whether the program is still there

evidence.native_pair_enumerated: 3 of 3 (COM11/COM12; only running firmware enumerates these)

note: the board DOES reset on the open - that is documented here and is why a native path captured before the open is stale - but the program survives it. Linux erases 3 of 3 on the same action.
conclusion: three hosts, three behaviours: Linux erases, Windows resets without erasing, macOS unmeasured
